name: TickTock
description: A modern countdown timer app with dark theme and red accents.

screens.name: TimersScreen
screens.purpose: Display and manage a list of active countdown timers.

features.name: timer-list
features.description: Displays a list of timers with remaining time.

features.name: timer-deletion
features.description: Allows deleting timers via swipe gesture.

features.name: haptic-feedback
features.description: Provides haptic feedback on timer completion.

screens.layout: List of timers in cards. Red accent for nearing deadlines.

screens.name: CreateTimerScreen
screens.purpose: Create new countdown timers with custom settings.

features.name: timer-creation
features.description: Allows users to create new timers with a name, end date, and description.

features.name: date-picker
features.description: Provides a date picker component for selecting the end date.

features.name: input-validation
features.description: Validates user input to ensure correct timer creation.

screens.layout: Form with text inputs, date picker, and save button.

screens.name: SettingsScreen
screens.purpose: Configure app settings like theme and notifications.

features.name: theme-selection
features.description: Allows users to switch between light and dark themes.

features.name: notification-settings
features.description: Controls notification preferences for timer completion.

screens.layout: List of settings options with toggles and descriptions.

screens.name: TimerDetailScreen
screens.purpose: Display a detailed view of a single timer.

features.name: timer-details
features.description: Shows timer name, description, and remaining time.

features.name: timer-reset
features.description: Resets the timer to the original end date.

screens.layout: Details view with editable fields and action buttons.

screens.name: EditTimerScreen

features.name: timer-editing
features.description: Allows users to modify timer name, end date, and description.

features.name: date-picker
features.description: Provides a date picker for easy end date selection.

features.name: input-validation
features.description: Validates user input before saving changes.

screens.layout: Form similar to CreateTimerScreen, pre-filled with timer data.
